title: LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7

achievements.reason: No Steam achievement list. Steam app 204120 ("LEGO® Harry Potter: Years 5-7") is in the store list and RAWG's store link points to it, but the Steam Web API returned an empty achievement schema and the global percentages call returned HTTP 403. RAWG lists 91 achievements with its own percentages; the 40 shown on its first page include Minikits, Red Bricks, studs, trophies, every character group, Duelling Club and Bonus Duelling feats, the Bonus Level, Year 8 and 100%, which could seed an original checklist.

game.blurb: Family action-adventure from Traveller's Tales and TT Fusion (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and Warner Bros. Interactive), published by Warner Bros. Interactive and Feral Interactive, released 2011-11-11. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters use the 24 level names on StrategyWiki's contents page, in groups of four.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4241). Steam app 204120 returned no achievements (see the collectible note), so steam=None and the chapters come from StrategyWiki page names (swNames). StrategyWiki has "LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7" at completion stage 0 (also in Category:Stubs); only its Table of Contents (about 2,300 characters) is written. Gameplay, Controls, Abilities, Characters, Extras, Cheat Codes, Achievements, Walkthrough and all 24 level pages are linked but not written. The chapters use its level names in contents order, from "Dark Times" to "The Flaw in the Plan"; RAWG's achievements name four of them ("Burning Bridges", "Fiendfyre Frenzy", "Snape's Tears", "The Flaw in the Plan"), matching the last levels. Groups of four are our own choice (the contents links do not say which level belongs to which year) and the summaries are only placeholders built from the page names. lego.fandom.com answers the API under "LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7" with about 82 linked articles (mostly characters and sets); names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG keeps a "LEGO Harry Potter Collection" (2016) entry as an addition.
